novelty_flags.label: Theorem 1 / ZhangTianBareinboim2022 comparison
novelty_flags.one_line: The claimed “strict domain extension” is not established: the bounded-density, fixed-Lipschitz, independent-rank class M_G is not shown to contain Zhang et al.'s arbitrary finite canonical SCM class, so replace “strict extension” with “informed by” or prove the required inclusion.

novelty_flags.label: Theorem 1
novelty_flags.one_line: The flagship-aspirant extension claim is phrased directly against only ZhangTianBareinboim2022; add a second direct comparator/frontier or promote the claim to a verified generic-class result.

soundness_flags.label: ass:inverse-cdf-semantics
soundness_flags.one_line: The inverse-transform categorical equation is standard, but BalazadehSyrgkanisKrishnan2022 does not support this named categorical-rank condition; replace the citation with an appropriate source.

soundness_flags.label: ass:rank-independence
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited BalazadehSyrgkanisKrishnan2022 paper does not define independent inverse-transform ranks or support their asserted district-noise independence; cite a source that does.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 5
soundness_flags.one_line: Conditional on checked positive lower endpoints and p0∈C_n, the population sign conclusion is only outer-set containment plus the definition of an infimum; the “additional sampling” sentence adds no formal substantive claim.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines a finite-sample neural estimator but identifies finite-sample guarantees as a future theoretical direction; its main mixed-variable result is asymptotic.
Canonical SCMs have finite endogenous and exogenous domains, and Theorem 2.4 preserves all counterfactual distributions for an arbitrary SCM with the same causal diagram.

source_verification_receipts.version: JASA final accepted preprint; journal record is JASA 104(487), 1071–1079
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The likelihood-level covering-collection construction yields multinomial confidence regions with coverage at least 1−alpha.
The paper constructs asymptotically valid, including uniform-in-P, random regions for an identified set and its image under a known function.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 2 and 5–10, Section 2 setup, Theorem 1, and Conclusion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper's setup places observed variables in R^d, proves tight convergence only for linear SCMs, and contains no inverse-transform or categorical-rank construction.

The paper introduces NCM structural inductive bias, separates expressiveness from learnability, and gives an identification/estimation procedure; it does not give exact coded-law endpoint certificates.

source_verification_receipts.version: JASA 119(547), author manuscript corresponding to the published article
source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 5, “Computing epsilon-sharp Bounds in Polynomial Programs”
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The method uses spatial branch-and-bound and valid dual outer bounds for discrete causal polynomial programs, with user-selected epsilon-sharpness or width stopping tolerances.
UA-DCM constructs neural min-max/max-min bounds over a confidence set around the empirical observational distribution to separate sample and nonidentification uncertainty; it is public preprint work.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Either prove that the published finite-canonical class embeds in the proposed bounded-density/Lipschitz/rank class, or remove every “strict extension” claim and position Theorem 1 as a new mixed-domain construction informed by finite canonicalization.
Make Theorem 1 a genuine comparator frontier by adding a second direct published comparator and a precise containment/noncontainment theorem against both methods.

Replace the UA-DCM sign corollary with a concrete Parents' Labor Supply numerical certificate, named action pair, and a theorem about certified decision stability not already implied by outer-set coverage.

Repair the two categorical-rank citations with a source explicitly defining inverse-CDF categorical SCM semantics and independent rank noise, then state exactly which independence is structural rather than merely a simulation convention.

recommended_next_step: Continue revision on this angle: repair the unsupported strict-extension framing and rank citations, and demote or substantively strengthen the UA-DCM corollary before advancing to Stage 0.
